decisions.question: Which input release is analyzed?
decisions.selected_rule: Freeze G0 release hash and exact field binding, together with G2 QA and any required G1 model release. No guessed raw variable names.
decisions.rationale: The call requires one stable schema and a version bridge.
decisions.sensitivity: Old/current values only in a separately labeled reconciliation branch.
decisions.reopen_rule: Upstream release, unit, definition or codebook evidence changes.

decisions.question: Which calendar years are in the plan?
decisions.selected_rule: Register every 2010–22 calendar year. Unobserved 2016 remains an explicit unavailable cell; no interpolation or carrying observations across years.
decisions.rationale: Time gaps must be visible in trends and changes.
decisions.sensitivity: Adjacent observed-wave changes retain actual year distance.
decisions.reopen_rule: A verified missing-year source is supplied.

decisions.question: What do the numbers represent?
decisions.selected_rule: Primary empirical cross-sections use measured rows with provenance keys. Panel-derived quantities require verified real plant IDs. Artificial-ID and fully synthetic branches are distinct demonstrations.
decisions.rationale: Measured values do not make manufactured links factual.
decisions.sensitivity: These are separate data modes, never pooled as robustness evidence.
decisions.reopen_rule: Verified real-ID crosswalk or source release arrives.

decisions.question: How is the comparison group defined?
decisions.selected_rule: Country dictionary must be exhaustive and exclusive. Fix 2014 EU and ASEAN membership for time comparison; time-varying membership is separate sensitivity. Known top-three reports stay top-three reports.
decisions.rationale: The group definition changes denominators and interpretation.
decisions.sensitivity: Explicit threshold/classification variants where relevant; never mutate main definitions.
decisions.reopen_rule: New annual questionnaire evidence invalidates the frozen classifier.

decisions.question: Whose distribution is shown?
decisions.selected_rule: Primary observed-sample descriptions use equal weight per eligible source row. National totals or population-weighted claims are blocked without a documented representative design.
decisions.rationale: The supplied sample is not automatically national.
alternatives: Validated official survey weight branch if later supplied
decisions.sensitivity: Separate weighted branch needs a frozen design and weighted-quantile rule before execution.
decisions.reopen_rule: A documented sampling-weight/design release becomes available.

decisions.question: How are unknown and unobserved values handled?
decisions.selected_rule: Missing≠zero. Keep structural absence, not asked, unknown, invalid and observed zero statuses. Primary verified-only results and working/provisional sensitivity use separate cell registries.
decisions.rationale: Sparse R&D, energy and geography may reflect questionnaires rather than economic outcomes.
decisions.sensitivity: Show sample differences as well as value differences.
decisions.reopen_rule: Field-year evidence clears or invalidates a value.

decisions.question: Which records support each outcome?
decisions.selected_rule: Ratios need their stated positive denominator; logs need positive value; zero/negative/missing exclusions are counted separately. No constant added to make logs exist.
decisions.rationale: The denominator and log domain change the sample.
decisions.sensitivity: Levels and logs are reported as distinct populations with counts.
decisions.reopen_rule: An outcome definition changes or invalid measurement is proved.

decisions.question: Which monetary units and price base apply?
decisions.selected_rule: Use concept-specific verified deflators and currency scale. Missing deflator yields missing real value; nominal values remain a separately named branch.
decisions.rationale: A nominal increase cannot be called real growth.
decisions.reopen_rule: Revised deflator, mapping or units evidence arrives.

decisions.question: How are yearly and pooled statistics formed?
decisions.selected_rule: Each eligible record enters its observed-year cell and one pooled plant-year cell. Pooled values are not unique-plant statistics; no duplicated join rows.
decisions.rationale: This makes pooling explicit and testable.
decisions.sensitivity: Fixed-cohort panel views only when real-linkage gate passes.
decisions.reopen_rule: Question requires a distinct fixed-cohort target.

decisions.question: Which summaries are fixed before view ing results?
decisions.selected_rule: For every requested continuous field: n, mean, SD, min, max, P 10, P 25, P 50, P 75, P 90, P 95. For known categories:count and explicit denominator share. Use Stata documented default percentiles and save command/version.
decisions.rationale: The entire family is fixed in advance, not selected for interesting patterns.
decisions.sensitivity: No hypothesis tests or causal regressions are added to descriptive rows merely to fill output slots.
decisions.reopen_rule: A reviewer id en ti fi es a missing original-statistic requirement.

decisions.question: Can extreme values be removed?
decisions.selected_rule: Retain valid outliers in main results. Predeclared sensitivity excludes values below P1 or above P99 within outcome-year, with source and group classifications fixed.
decisions.rationale: Silent cleaning can manufacture distribution changes.
decisions.sensitivity: No win sori zed replacement of source values; show removed counts.
decisions.reopen_rule: A value is confirmed unit/coding error in upstream QA.

decisions.question: How are sparse result cells displayed?
decisions.selected_rule: Always register cell and n. Mark n<10 thin; do not draw unstable detailed-sector distribution panels when n<10. Keep permitted numerical cell with thin flag; apply actual BPS disclosure rules if provided.
decisions.rationale: Thin-cell clarity is separate from official disclosure policy.
alternatives: Main graphic limited to adequately supported cells
decisions.reopen_rule: An actual disclosure rule or statistical support requirement supersedes this display rule.

decisions.question: How are incomplete product, energy or factor data compared?
decisions.selected_rule: Use complete required-component universe for primary accounting; observed partial sums separate. Every numerator and denominator shares the same eligibility mask for the requested ratio.
decisions.rationale: Reported small sums can reflect missing components.
decisions.sensitivity: Vary component coverage and factor assumptions oneat a time.
decisions.reopen_rule: A verified source resolves the missing components or annual factor.

decisions.question: What row-specific calculation is selected?
decisions.selected_rule: Build firm-destination-year values with exhaustive geographic group membership and documented time-varying EU/ASEAN conventions. Compute concentration/diversification with known denominators; define the high-environmental-standard classification independently of outcomes. Link feasibility to R5.
decisions.rationale: Preserves the repository row-specific interpretation and records changes separately.
decisions.sensitivity: Specialist branches below isolate mapping, threshold, tie, period and denominator choices.
decisions.reopen_rule: New evidence, current owner correction or independent method review requires revision.

decisions.question: Which results lead the row report?
decisions.selected_rule: First4 core exhibits where useful, then diagnostics and complete indexed appendix. Individually runnable row module saves outputs before other rows proceed.
decisions.rationale: Deasy explicitly requests interpretable staged results, not one opaque grand run.
decisions.sensitivity: Never choose core based on statistical significance.
decisions.reopen_rule: Current owner changes question or reader finds core uninterpretable.
